import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')
data['model_year'] = pd.to_numeric(data['model_year'])
data['weight_grams'] = pd.to_numeric(data['weight_grams'])
data['max_iso'] = pd.to_numeric(data['max_iso'])
data['price_usd'] = pd.to_numeric(data['price_usd'])
data['megapixels'] = pd.to_numeric(data['megapixels'])

# Create a scatter plot of megapixels vs price
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='megapixels', y='price_usd', data=data)
plt.title('Megapixels vs Price of Digital Cameras')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a bar chart of sensor types
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.countplot(x='sensor_type', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Sensor Types')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sensor_types.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of camera weights
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(data['weight_grams'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Camera Weights')
plt.xlabel('Weight (grams)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('camera_weights.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
